title: Honkai: Star Rail
description: A free-to-play space-fantasy RPG in which the Trailblazer travels aboard the Astral Express, explores different worlds and builds character teams for turn-based battles.

player_sentiment.summary: Sampled PC user reviews across different updates praise character presentation and strategic team combat, while some criticize gacha pressure, repetition and lengthy dialogue; this is not a current-version consensus.
positives: Music and world-building appeal to some
negatives: Lengthy dialogue and uneven story pacing
